title: Implement Museum Dark Charcoal, Rich Burgundy & Muted Gold Design System with Serif/Sans Typography
description: Overhaul the entire color palette and typography system: Foundation in Deep Charcoal (#1A1A1A to #2A2A2A) acting as a museum wall canvas, Primary Accent in Rich Burgundy (#6B1C23) for active navigation states and secondary elements, Highlights & CTAs in Muted Gold (#C5A059 / #D4AF37) for visual luxury, and Soft Ivory/Cream (#F4F1EA & #E0E0E0) for text to prevent eye strain. Apply Playfair Display serif for headings and Geist sans for body text across all components.
acceptanceCriteria: globals.css and layout.tsx define Deep Charcoal (#1A1A1A, #242424, #2A2A2A), Rich Burgundy (#6B1C23), Muted Gold (#C5A059, #D4AF37), and Soft Ivory/Cream (#F4F1EA, #E0E0E0)
Headings configured with Playfair Display serif font, body and UI text configured with Geist sans
Sticky Header & India Circus Mega-Menu updated with charcoal background, burgundy active states, and gold highlights
Hero Carousel, Custom Frame Studio, and Category Pills updated to museum dark canvas with gold CTAs
Curated Collections, Framing Journey, The Atelier Glass Slider, Customer Lookbook, FAQ Accordion, and Site Footer fully styled in dark museum luxury
All Playwright tests updated and passing (30/30)
